name: dev-hooks
description: Polyglot dev-workflow hooks for Claude Code: auto-lint on edit, verify tests/linters before stopping (routing test runs through rtk when installed, to shrink the failure feedback), a PreToolUse dangerous-command guard, per-prompt JSONL logging that feeds the weekly automation review, and reminder hooks for plaintext secrets, leftover debug statements, leftover TODO/FIXME markers, missing tests, stack-aware skills, multi-session plans, review-before-finishing, end-of-session memory capture, dev-env-standard gaps, Dockerfile layer ordering (hadolint on write), popover/tooltip positioning, database-migration safety (reversibility/backfill/lock-aware DDL), web accessibility gaps (alt/labels/keyboard), string-interpolated SQL injection, swallowed exceptions, GitHub Actions supply-chain security (SHA-pinning + ref resolution), inline-SVG-to-icon-library, use-the-framework-generator scaffolding, outdated dependency pins, large uncommitted changes, and a self-stocking/self-advertising personal CLI-script library (SessionStart index of your saved tools + end-of-session nudge to keep reusable one-offs). Ships the companion skills the hooks point at: dev-env-setup (mise + hk + CI + gitleaks + project-docs standard, version-tracked), github-actions (workflow supply-chain security checklist + fleet-wide SHA-pin/bump), dependency-upgrade (bump JS/Ruby/Python/Actions deps to latest with changelog-aware major handling and test-gated incremental commits), env-to-fnox (migrate plaintext .env secrets to fnox), dockerfile (cache-friendly layer ordering + gotchas), popovers-tooltips (collision-aware positioning with Floating UI in a Stimulus controller, plus Tippy/Flowbite/native Popover API), accessibility (on-demand WCAG 2.2/ARIA audit of changed frontend files with a heuristic a11y_audit.py, plus Rails/Hotwire + React fixes), tailwind (design tokens, taming class soup via component extraction, dark mode, responsive, and accessibility), worktree-setup (provision a freshly-created git worktree: trust its mise.toml, copy gitignored secrets/config like Rails master.key and .env from the main checkout, and re-mark shebang scripts executable), and repo-review (whole-repository severity-ranked audit across correctness, performance, smells, architecture, security, test health, dev-env, dependencies, CI supply-chain, secrets, and — for web repos — accessibility and docs; delegates to the specialist skills/commands and ships a read-only detect_stack.sh preflight; report-only, stack-agnostic counterpart to rails-audit), and script-library (genericize a one-off script into a standalone PEP 723 / uv-run CLI with a # short-description: line and save it to ~/.local/bin, where the script-index hook surfaces it next session).
